what: vLLM decode after updating vllm-tt-plugin 3d03d71 -> c127c17 (12 commits)

local_repeat_rate.definition: fraction of first 40 generated tokens already seen in the preceding 4

reading: Looping is gone. Agreement-with-CPU is not the defect metric: it fell because greedy paths diverge benignly under bf16, the same way the direct tt_transformers path diverges. The defect was the repetition, and it is no longer present.
caveat: The old baseline JSON does not record the server's max_model_len or plugin SHA, so config differences between the two runs cannot be fully excluded. The qualitative change matches the upstream fix 'return None from sample_tokens when no pending forward'.
